detail.rule: Verified evidence receipts and successful live direct-provider executions are separate dimensions. Strict provider lanes keep exact-response identity rules and each contributor occupies at most one slot. Basic may additionally count a server-adjudicated dual-authority contradiction bundle toward verified evidence only; authority pages never count as live provider execution. Pro/Advanced never inherit that exception, and partial/request-bound evidence never satisfies the strict receipt threshold.
